long_biography.plain_text:
Kaimakli-born Christodoulou came to London with his family after the 1974 invasion of Cyprus. He left school at 16 and learned diamond mounting, then put jewellery-trade earnings into a studio apartment. Building-site work led to his own construction projects, and rising asset values gave him collateral for larger purchases.

That repeated cycle of development, refinancing and acquisition created the capital base behind Yianis. Christodoulou kept 100% control as the portfolio broadened from housing into commercial premises and hospitality. He remains an active director of Yianis Group and numerous related property companies.
